authority.rule: Upstream construction records are canonical where they define overlapping ZKP semantics. This file maps downstream evidence; it does not redefine upstream records.

local_predicate_labels.rule: PR-* labels remain useful for locating historical fixtures and profiles but MUST NOT be treated as canonical semantic primitives when an upstream construction record defines the overlapping proposition.

upstream_records.note: Equality of a hidden scalar across authenticated commitments is construction evidence for hidden-value equality when the authenticated-field/opening contract is satisfied.

The same relation can support common-control evidence only when the hidden scalar is explicitly the controller secret under the selected identifier/key profile; the local profile alone does not establish those credential/key semantics.

limits: does not establish credential authenticity by itself
does not establish canonical DTG field-to-scalar encoding
does not establish independent interoperability for the exact DTG profile

upstream_records.note: Pedersen-style commitment/opening evidence maps to the blinded-binder construction family, including the local negative case that deterministic/visible binders can remain correlatable.

limits: commitment opening does not authenticate the source credential
fresh blinding does not by itself establish presentation unlinkability
record 022 is not part of the pinned canonical main and is therefore not mapped here

upstream_records.note: Credential-status freshness and privacy-preserving status evidence overlap non-revocation/currentness semantics.
Authenticated carried snapshots can supply roots used by set-membership proofs, but registry authority and semantic type remain external to the proof.

limits: registry membership, accreditation, authorization and credential status remain distinct semantics
live lookup privacy degradation is deployment guidance rather than a construction record
authoritative freshness rules remain externally governed

upstream_records.note: Anonymous holder-binding evidence is relevant to holder binding, but the pinned record 004 requires a specific same-secret/key-derivation relation that BBS evidence does not automatically establish.
Selective disclosure and unlinkability evidence may support a pairwise-edge profile, but record 011 composes additional co-control, revocation and transcript semantics not supplied by BBS alone.

limits: BBS selective disclosure is not a substitute for DTG relation semantics
external BBS interoperability does not establish interoperability for composed DTG records

upstream_records.note: Primary positive/negative outcome fixture family for Community-Anchored Proof.
Membership-root conditions.
Scoped reuse/nullifier cases where the context requests reuse detection.
Challenge/transcript-binding negative case.
Holder-binding condition.
Distinct-member/self-vouch boundary.
Current/revocation cases.
Presenter/voucher identifier co-control where identifiers differ.

limits: the harness is semantic evidence, not proof-system execution evidence
CAP-006 remains indeterminate when third-party membership linkage evidence is unavailable

upstream_records.note: Stable visible binder/equality correlation pressure tests reinforce record 008's explicit non-unlinkability boundary.
Tests against accidental cross-context correlation complement intentional-correlation semantics.
Delegation ancestry disclosure/linkability tests are additive assurance evidence.
Authority-chain ancestry/status correlation tests are additive assurance evidence.

limits: privacy-pressure tests do not redefine record statements or disclosure sets
local adversary classes remain downstream assurance vocabulary

upstream_records.note: Useful adversarial evidence for mutual-edge admissibility, but canonical main still holds record 013 at requested state.

limits: do not freeze placeholder record-013 semantics
relationship-level unlinkability must not be inferred from privacy of one credential half

upstream_records.note: Task request/challenge/audience semantics depend on transcript binding.
Task-context hiding/citation correlation maps to the blinded-binder seam.
Delegation-chain invocation is distinct from proof of delegation authority and remains a task/framework integration concern.
Authority proof does not establish action completion; task outcome evidence remains external.

limits: task completion and receipts are framework artifacts, not ZKP proof results

retirement_candidates.local_surface: PR-REL as a canonical predicate abstraction
retirement_candidates.replacement: Use upstream record 009 for hidden-value equality; use record 007 only when common-control semantics are actually present.

retirement_candidates.local_surface: PR-HID as a canonical predicate abstraction
retirement_candidates.replacement: Use upstream record 008 for the blinded-binder proposition; retain local implementation labels only as evidence identifiers.

retirement_candidates.local_surface: PR-RES as a single semantic bucket
retirement_candidates.replacement: Use record 006 for non-revocation/currentness proof semantics and keep registry/accreditation/authorization resolution behavior as explicit downstream/external profiles.

retirement_candidates.local_surface: local evidence-state vocabulary as normative lifecycle
retirement_candidates.replacement: Map to upstream requested → specified → constructed → run → vetted → published where applicable; preserve stronger downstream assurance gates only as additive local evidence controls.

intentionally_unmapped.surface: deployment, operations, RAHP/DPIP assurance, incident, redress and risk-acceptance fixtures
intentionally_unmapped.reason: These are downstream implementation/assurance extensions and do not correspond one-to-one with an upstream construction record.
Operational capability and fallback policy are not cryptographic construction semantics.
